sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- If you own the "The Unheard" edition of the game you will start with this item.
- Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market, be sold to traders or destroyed.
- While a player is wearing the radio in the PvE and PvE co-op game modes:
  - In-raid cash services (e.g. car extractions) have a 50% discount
  - Insurance returns are 30% faster
  - Killing Scavs without being shot first results in a -0.05 Scav karma penalty - The penalty can be negated by killing a PMC
  - Scav kill experience is reduced by 50%
  - With 6+ Scav karma, Scavs don't shoot on sight if 60+ meters away, unless provoked
- This item is not lootable from players and can only be placed in a special item slot.

sections.heading: Quest Rewards
sections.text:
- 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from Small Business - Part 3
- Note: The reward is only obtainable in the PvE game mode and not available to owners of the "The Unheard" edition of the game.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: Easter eggs and References: The item is modeled after the "H4855 Personal Role Radio", although it is unusable as a radio in-game.
